description: This file defines the BasketItem entity class used within the application's domain model, encapsulating properties and methods managing a basket item's data and behavior.

classes.name: BasketItem
classes.description: Represents an item in a shopping basket, including properties for unit price, quantity, catalog item ID, and basket ID, with methods to set and add quantities.

methods.name: BasketItem
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new basket item with catalog item ID, quantity, and unit price.

methods.name: AddQuantity
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity to the basket item's current quantity, with validation.

methods.name: SetQuantity
methods.description: Sets the basket item's quantity to a specified value, with validation.
